cauchy-integral-theorem-boundary-ident-8.title: Cauchy's Integral Theorem
cauchy-integral-theorem-boundary-ident-8.interpretation: Asserts that the line integral of an analytic function around a closed contour is identically zero, provided the function is analytic everywhere on and inside the boundary.
cauchy-integral-theorem-boundary-ident-8.symmetry_origin: The conservative nature of analytic fields in the complex manifold, analogous to irrotational flow in vector calculus.
cauchy-integral-theorem-boundary-ident-8.limits_and_boundary: Only holds for simply connected regions; the presence of poles or branch cuts within the contour shatters the zero-net-integral result.
